// A stand-in for a minified bundle: every place a "</" can legally sit in JS.
// Kept as .txt so `node --test` does not run it. Evaluated by render-map-html.test.mjs.
globalThis.out = [
  "a<b</c".replace(/</g, "&lt;"),
  /<\/script>/i.test("</SCRIPT>"),
  /<\/Script\s*>/.source,
  "</script><b>",
  '</ScRiPt >'.length,
  `</script>${1 + 1}`,
  "x</y".split(/<\//).length,
];
